title: Ezra
author: Traditionally associated with Ezra the priest and scribe.
date: After the Babylonian exile, during the Persian period.
audience: The returned exiles, calling them to rebuild worship and return to covenant faithfulness.
historicalSetting: Ezra records the return from exile, the rebuilding of the temple, opposition, and Ezra's ministry of teaching the Law.
keyVerse: Ezra 7:10 — "For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh's law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel."
christFocus: Ezra points to Christ by showing the need for restoration, true worship, and obedience fulfilled in Him. The rebuilt temple anticipates the fuller presence of God in Christ.
outline: First return and temple rebuilding — Ezra 1-6
Ezra's return and teaching ministry — Ezra 7-10
